content: The Psychosis Research Unit, part of the Greater Manchester Mental Health Trust and the Division of Psychology and Mental Health at the University of Manchester in the United Kingdom, is actively involved in initiatives aimed at reducing the impact of schizophrenia. Dr. Gagandeep Singh, from the Department of Neurology at Dayanand Medical College in Ludhiana, India, contributes to research in epilepsy and seizures in the South-East Asia region. Ms. Sahar Vasquez, associated with Mind Health Connect in Belize City, Belize, focuses on lived experiences and advocacy in the Americas. Professor Min Zhao, from the Shanghai Drug Abuse Treatment Center and the Shanghai Mental Health Center at Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine in China, specializes in the treatment and prevention of substance use disorders, as well as mental health and addiction in the Western Pacific region. Annex 1 lists contributors to the guideline development process, including 143 members of the evidence review and synthesis teams. Stephanie Wong from Flinders University, Australia, and the University of Sydney, Australia. Annex 2 outlines the management of declarations of interest and conflicts of interest. All contributors declared no conflicts of interest, except for specific cases where potential conflicts were identified and managed appropriately. For example: Professor Henry Brodaty declared consultancy payments from pharmaceutical companies and ongoing research support from Australia’s National Health Medical Research Council (NHMRC) and the Commonwealth Department of Health. No conflicts of interest were identified. Dr. Vladimir Carli is a shareholder of Mental Health in Mind International AB. No conflicts of interest were identified. Professor Graham Thornicroft serves on multiple boards related to global mental health and receives support from the National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR). No conflicts of interest were identified. The guideline development process adhered to strict protocols to ensure transparency and integrity in managing potential conflicts of interest.
